SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA
Amendment to the Master Circular for Investment Advisers
SEBI/HO/IMD/IMD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/88 dated June 2, 2025, issued in supersession of
SEBI/HO/IMD/IMD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2024/49

5.1 Record retention
An investment adviser must retain all records of investment advice, client agreements, and
risk profiling for a period of 8 years from the date of the relevant interaction.
